{"expiry":1794198579240,"value":{"tags":["6061","6061 black label","bicycle","bike","bikereturn","black label","discountx","fixed gear","label","premium","promo-valid","refund_fee:4500","rtly-carrier-account-tag:fedex","rtly-gc:offer-free-shipping","rtly-shipping-rate:45","rtnly-dimensions-lwh:52_29_7","white"],"collections":[],"product":{"id":7835017478231,"title":"State Bicycle Co. x Liquid Death - 6061 Black Label v3","body_html":"

Murder your thirst. Then murder the group ride. The 6061 Black Label v3 in a full Liquid Death collaboration — two colorways, dripping-skull artwork across the top tube, and a black carbon fork that fades into the frame color.

This is not a decal on a stock bike. It's the v3 we build all year, painted two ways it has never been painted, as part of a collection that runs from the frameset to the cap on your head.

Two colorways

Two ways to go out. Same bike underneath — the paint is the whole argument:

Colorway 24 Karat Casket

Black into gold. Gold-outlined wordmark, the skull in gold across the top tube, and enough shine on it to look like it was buried with somebody important.

Colorway Scary Strawberry

Hot pink into black, with the same skull artwork and the wordmark in white. Sweet right up until it isn't.

Both share the same treatment: a black carbon fork with a fade into the frame color and a skull-and-crossbones crown detail, black deep-section wheels, black cockpit, the dripping-skull artwork across the top tube, and the State wordmark running full-length down the down tube in white.

Same frame, same spec, same price. Neither one is the "better" bike — pick the paint you want to look at.

What's underneath the paint

Lightweight 6061 double-butted aluminum with a tapered head tube and a full carbon fork and steerer. Stiff where you want it, and light enough to carry up a flight of stairs without resenting it.

Clearance for 38c and beyond. The v3 frame and the 19mm internal-width wheels take far more rubber than a track bike traditionally does — smooth tarmac, chewed-up city streets, a bit of tracklocross if that's your evening. It ships on Vittoria 30c tires, which is the sensible middle.

48x17, with unlimited skid patches. The ratio that balances a city's stop-and-go against actually getting somewhere, on a CNC'd 144 BCD chainring and crank that lets you change your mind later.

Internal cable routing keeps the lines out of the weather and off the frame, and front and rear caliper brakes are included — fit them or don't, it's your bike and your flip-flop hub.

The cockpit

Black throughout, to let the frame do the talking. The stem is a 31.8mm oversized clamp with a 90mm extension, on a 27.2mm post and a premium aerodynamic race saddle.

Sizing

  • 49cm — riders 5'1" – 5'5"
  • 52cm — riders 5'4" – 5'9"
  • 55cm — riders 5'8" – 5'11"
  • 58cm — riders 5'10" – 6'2"
  • 61cm — riders 6'1" – 6'5"

Sizes overlap. If you're between two, the smaller is more nimble and the larger stretches you out. Full numbers are on our geometry chart.

Specifications

Frame 6061-grade double-butted aluminum, tapered head tube
Fork Full carbon fiber fork and steerer, paint-matched fade
Dropouts Aluminum-plated horizontal
Wheelset Black Label mid profile, 19mm internal width
Hub Sealed low-flange flip-flop — fixed or single speed (freewheel not included)
Crank Black Label track crank, 170mm
Chainring 144 BCD
Gear ratio 48x17
Stem 31.8mm oversized clamp, 90mm extension
Handlebars Compact drops, or wide risers with Vans grips
Brakes Front and rear calipers included
Pedals Wellgo alloy with toe cages
Seatpost 27.2mm
Saddle Premium aerodynamic race saddle
Tires Vittoria 30c
Max tire 35c x 700 recommended
Weight 18 lb 5 oz with wide riser bars

Riders have fitted up to 38–40c, but fitment varies with wheel and tire brand, and a larger tire may need a longer chain to get the clearance.

The rest of the collection

The same artwork runs across the whole drop:

  • 6061 v3 Frameset — $549.99. Frame and matching fork with the gradient fade and skull-and-crossbones crown. For the parts bin, or for building something that isn't a singlespeed.
  • Cycling jersey — $69.99. Full zip, red flame wordmark across the chest, psychedelic skull across the back.
  • Saddle — $35.00. Dripping skull and "Murder Your Thirst" on the tail, SBC monogram on the nose.
  • Cycling cap — SOLD OUT. Black with a white-and-gold center stripe, wordmark under the brim.
  • Stem cap — $9.99. The skull, full-bleed to the edge.

Limited quantities — when it's gone, it's gone.

⚠️ Assembly Required: This bike ships partially unassembled and needs handlebar, pedal, saddle and front wheel installation, plus general setup and tuning. We strongly recommend professional assembly.
